messages:
maria: Kicking off: quick design callout — required markers vs inline summary errors + destructive confirm copy. Thoughts? @sam @lee sam: prefer inline for field-level errors. users expect immediate feedback. summary only for long forms. aj: does inline mean we remove top summary entirely? confusion if multiple fields error. maria: idea: combine — inline per-field + small error summary at top listing count + "jump to" links. lee: a11y note: required markers must be programmatically determinable. avoid color-only. add aria-required and visible labels. sam: agree. also inline errors should include role="alert" for screen readers. maria: for destructive actions (delete model, clear cache) — modal vs inline confirm? current pattern uses modal with checkbox "I understand". feels heavy. aj: maybe inline "type the resource name" for highest-risk ops, and toast for small removals. sam: engineering note: typed confirmations add implementation cost but reduce accidental deletes. also consider undo snackbar instead of blocking modal. lee: accessibility: typing confirmations are okay but ensure focus trap and keyboard access in modal. undo snackbar should be accessible and persistent for screen readers. maria: proposed copy options: - Modal: "Delete deployment? This action cannot be undone. Type the deployment name to confirm." - Inline: "Click 'Delete' to permanently remove deployment. This cannot be undone." with an extra small input? aj: can we standardize across console: high-risk = typed confirm, medium-risk = modal with checkbox, low-risk = undo toast. sam: sounds good. any objections to showing required marker (asterisk) plus "(required)" visually for clarity? lee: asterisk alone is ambiguous. use visible text "Required" on hover? better to add explicit label e.g. "Label * Required" or show both. maria: ok action items: sam to prototype inline+summary pattern w/ aria alerts; lee to write a11y checklist for required markers + modals; aj to draft policy table (risk -> confirmation pattern). target for next design review in a week. sam: I'll drop a prototype link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/validation-proto maria: thanks! also adding copy options to the doc. @aj please add to product notes. aj: will do. :thumbsup: deploy-bot: Deployed draft of validation styles to staging at 2025-11-15T14:12Z maria: cool — can everyone glance on staging and add quick reactions? :eyes: lee: will test keyboard flow tomorrow. sam: added a small code snippet for role alert: ```
Please enter a valid name
``` aj: nice. no blockers from product. maria: wrap-up: followups posted in the design doc. thanks all. :partyparrot:
